subject: Compilation Error - 'conn_rec' has no member named 'remote_ip'

messages.author: faa5427c06a1e034
messages.subject: Compilation Error - 'conn_rec' has no member named 'remote_ip'
parts:
I am facing the following error while compiling RApache on CentOS, 32 bit, installed as a virtual machine on Windows using Oracle Virtual Box.

I could do configuration successfully with:

./configure --with-R=/usr/local/bin/R --with-apache2-apxs=/usr/local/apache2/bin/apxs

When I run make. It end with the following error.

Compiling mod_R

/usr/local/apache2/bin/apxs -I/usr/local/lib/R/include -I/home/centos/src/RApache/rapache/libapreq2/include  -I/usr/local/apache2/include  -c mod_R.c -Wl,-rpath,/usr/local/lib/R/lib -L/usr/local/lib/R/lib -lR -L/home/centos/src/RApache/rapache/libapreq2/library/.libs -lapreq2
/usr/local/apache2/build/libtool --silent --mode=compile gcc -std=gnu99 -prefer-pic   -DLINUX=2 -D_REENTRANT -D_GNU_SOURCE -D_LARGEFILE64_SOURCE -g -O2 -pthread -I/usr/local/apache2/include  -I/usr/local/apache2/include   -I/usr/local/apache2/include  -I/usr/local/lib/R/include -I/home/centos/src/RApache/rapache/libapreq2/include -I/usr/local/apache2/include  -c -o mod_R.lo mod_R.c && touch mod_R.slo
mod_R.c: In function 'RApache_getServer':
mod_R.c:2009: error: 'conn_rec' has no member named 'remote_ip'
mod_R.c:2009: error: 'conn_rec' has no member named 'remote_ip'
apxs:Error: Command failed with rc=65536
.
make: *** [mod_R.so] Error 1

Could you please help?

Regards
Santosh

messages.author: 25a4f5811cd7d59e
messages.subject: Re: Compilation Error - 'conn_rec' has no member named 'remote_ip'
parts:
What version of apache are you using? Unfortunately I just found out
that remote_ip structure element available in the 2.2.x series has
been changed to peer_ip in the 2.4.x series.

Jeff

messages.subject: Re: Compilation Error - 'conn_rec' has no member named 'remote_ip'
parts:
The apache version 2.4.2 is installed at /usr/local/apache2 directory. 

But this version is not in the PATH.

[centos@localhost bin]$ whereis httpd
httpd: /usr/sbin/httpd.worker /usr/sbin/httpd.event /usr/sbin/httpd /etc/httpd /usr/lib/httpd /usr/share/man/man8/httpd.8.gz
[centos@localhost bin]$ 

Current httpd is:

[centos@localhost bin]$ which httpd
/usr/sbin/httpd
[centos@localhost bin]$ 

So when I run httpd -v, it uses /usr/sbin/httpd which is version 2.2.15

[centos@localhost bin]$ httpd -v

Server version: Apache/2.2.15 (Unix)
Server built:   Dec  8 2011 18:07:26

[centos@localhost bin]$ 

But, the make (RApache) seems to be using the version 2.4.2 because I can see /usr/local/apache2 in the error logs which I sent earlier.

Sorry for not being clear in my previous response. Thank you very much for your support. 

Regards
Santosh
